providerInventory.physical_evidence: Live CLEAN project leqcwgzvjsxugfgzdmth (Postgres 17) with the uskoci-ai-interview Edge function deployed and one private Storage bucket profile-media; the app has no other backend.
providerInventory.technical_purpose: Primary cloud platform: Postgres database, Auth, PostgREST API, Storage and Edge Functions runtime for every client call.

providerInventory.physical_evidence: supabase/functions/uskoci-ai-interview/index.ts callOpenAI posts to https://api.openai.com/v1/responses. Runtime selection depends on the AI_PROVIDER and OPENAI_API_KEY secrets, which this unit cannot read, so coverage is required fail-safe until authorized operations retire the unused adapter.
providerInventory.technical_purpose: External AI provider adapter for the AI interview turn (Responses API).

providerInventory.physical_evidence: supabase/functions/uskoci-ai-interview/index.ts callGemini posts to generativelanguage.googleapis.com and is the default route when GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL are set without AI_PROVIDER. Runtime selection is not readable by this unit, so coverage is required fail-safe.
providerInventory.technical_purpose: External AI provider adapter for the AI interview turn (generateContent API).

providerInventory.physical_evidence: notification_push_devices and notification_push_attempts exist (N06/N07 registry) but no Edge function or job in this repository calls exp.host; the transport is not admitted, so this provider processes no personal data yet.
providerInventory.technical_purpose: Push transport candidate for Expo push tickets and receipts.
